blocks.text: Numbers 12 contains 16 verses. It opens with: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman. It concludes with: And afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Proposed maps of the wilderness route should label uncertain site identifications rather than presenting a single itinerary reconstruction as established.
